news_cards.title: Bihar Mein 51600 Karod Rupye Ka Nivesh, Steel Hub Banega Bihar
bullets: Mukhyamantri ke anusaar, desh ke pramukh udyogik samuhon ke saath MoU par hastakshar kiye gaye hain, jiske tahat Bihar mein 51600 karod rupye ka nivesh hoga.
Is nivesh ke tahat, Bihar ko steel hub banaya jayega, saath hi textile aur nuclear urja kshetra ko bhi badhava milega.
Yeh nivesh Bihar sarkar ki arthik vikas ki yojanaon ke tahat aaya hai, jiska uddeshya rajya ko arthik roop se majboot banana hai.

news_cards.title: JP Ganga Path Ko Milega Vishwa Stariya Swaroop
bullets: Mukhyamantri ne JP Ganga path ko vishwa stariya swaroop dena shuru kiya hai, jiske tahat 65 kilometer ganga channel viksit kiya jayega.
Is pariyojana ke tahat, Bihar ke logon ko sujhav aayega aur rajya ki arthik sthiti mein sudhar hoga.
Yeh pariyojana Bihar sarkar ki infrastructure vikas ki yojanaon ke tahat aayi hai, jiska uddeshya rajya ko adhunik banana hai.

news_cards.title: Bihar Mein Nishulk Steamer Ferry Seva Shuru
bullets: Mukhyamantri ne Nasiriganj-Panapar nishulk steamer ferry seva ka shubharambh kiya hai, jisse logon ko sujhav aayega.
Is seva ke tahat, Nasiriganj-Panapar ke beech yatra karna sujhav aur surakshit hoga.
Yeh seva Bihar sarkar ki jan suvidha ki yojanaon ke tahat aayi hai, jiska uddeshya rajya ke logon ko sujhav pradan karna hai.

news_cards.title: Bihar Mein MoU Brahmakumari Samaj Ke Saath
bullets: Bihar sarkar ne Brahmakumari samaj ke saath MoU par hastakshar kiye hain, jiske tahat nasha mukt abhiyan chalaya jayega.
Is MoU ke tahat, Bihar mein nasha mukt abhiyan ko badhava milega aur logon ko jankari pradan ki jayegi.
Yeh MoU Bihar sarkar ki samajik suraksha ki yojanaon ke tahat aaya hai, jiska uddeshya rajya ke logon ko surakshit rakhna hai.
